coastline.processing: Retain the Japan geometry including interior rings; round geographic coordinates to 6 decimal places; strip all source properties.

landMask.encoding: Base64; row0 is south, column0 is west; each row is 2 bytes, little-endian bits, x0 in least-significant bit.
landMask.sampling: Natural Earth polygon contains test at the centres of 16x16 subcells; holes are preserved.
landMask.landFraction: Rounded permille of actual polygon intersection area from the terrain CSV; mask fraction if unavailable.

demQualityCodes.0: Available sampled DEM including genuine zero and negative pixel values.
demQualityCodes.1: All sampled DEM pixels were zero: ambiguous source fill; heights are null and coverage is 0.
demQualityCodes.2: Missing DEM or no land pixel centre samples: heights are null and coverage is 0.
demQualityCodes.3: Census population exists outside the generalized Natural Earth coastline: preserve population; heights are null and coverage is 0.

demCoverage: Available land source-pixel centres divided by expected land source-pixel centres at zoom9, rounded to permille. Ambiguous or missing cells have 0 coverage.
missingValuePolicy: Never replace unavailable elevation with zero. Omit nonzero DEM outside Japan coastline unless needed to preserve census population.
